scripts.start:redis: docker start my-redis || docker run -d --name my-redis -p 6379:6379 redis
scripts.start: pnpm run start:redis && dotenv -e .env -e .env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development node dist/src/main.js
scripts.start:debug: pnpm run start:redis && dotenv -e .env -e .env.development -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development node --inspect=127.0.0.1:9229 dist/src/main.js
scripts.start:dev: pnpm run start:redis && dotenv -e .env -e .env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development node dist/src/main.js
scripts.dev: pnpm run start:redis && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ts-node-dev --files -r tsconfig-paths/register --respawn src/main.ts
scripts.dev:debug: pnpm run start:redis && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ts-node-dev --inspect=127.0.0.1:9229 --files -r tsconfig-paths/register --respawn src/main.ts
scripts.dev:test: pnpm run start:redis && cross-env NODE_ENV=test ts-node-dev --files -r tsconfig-paths/register --respawn src/main.ts
scripts.dev:prod: pnpm run start:redis && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ts-node-dev --files -r tsconfig-paths/register --respawn src/main.ts
